title: Pigmentation and redness are not the same problem
summary: Both show up as uneven tone, but the underlying cause, and the right treatment, are different.
body:
Pigmentation and redness are often described the same way by patients, but they arise from different mechanisms: one is excess melanin, the other is visible vessels close to the surface.

Correctly telling the two apart at consultation is what determines whether a course of IPL, pigment-targeting laser or a gentler peel is the right starting point.

Many patients present with a combination of both, which is why treatment plans are often sequenced rather than combined into a single session, addressing the dominant concern first and reassessing before moving on.
